source_scope: FAVORIT Листовые материалы, section 1 sheets 1.1-1.12, physical PDF pages 4-15
critical_findings: The 12 high-priority section-1 catalog transcription queue records were manually re-read from the supplied rendered pages and resolved; no pixel-derived dimensions were introduced.
Six source-defined facade-subframe system variants from sheet 1.2 are now explicit machine topology records instead of an implicit prose dependency.
Sheets 1.5-1.12 now provide a 36-entry component catalog; source numbering skips 24-27 and the machine does not synthesize those entries.
Sheet 1.8 prints four paronite gasket sizes but only three designations. The size tuples are stored, automatic designation mapping is blocked, and the mismatch is an explicit source anomaly.

Twenty-four source-wide technical facts were typed from sheets 1.2-1.4, including bracket/extension/profile/flashing thickness ranges, insulation densities/thickness, cladding thickness/joint width, fire-cutoff interval claims and six installation tolerances.
Fourteen SP/GOST/TU references printed by the manufacturer were recorded only as claimed_by_source_not_independently_verified. None is promoted to a production normative rule.

Ten explicit dimensioned component variants were added (four paronite size tuples, two rivets, one press-washer screw, three angle-plate nomenclature tuples); every new record remains commit_allowed=false.
